caption: The drawing depicts a lidded ceramic pot with two horizontal handles on either side. The pot features a wide, rounded body that tapers toward a small, slightly raised base, and the lid is conical with a small knob at the top. The entire pot, including the handles and lid, is decorated with evenly spaced horizontal stripes in alternating colors: reddish-brown, black, green, and a muted off-white or beige. The stripes continue uninterrupted across the body, handles, and lid, creating a uniform appearance. The background of the drawing is plain and light beige, with no additional objects or decorations present. The illustration is centered, and the shading around the pot suggests a three-dimensional form.
title: Jar with Cover
